changelog:
- Added detailed documentation (SKILL.md) describing model support, workflow steps, security, and data handling.
- Outlined support for multiple AI image models (Midjourney, Grok, nano-banana-2, Seedream 5.0) with pricing, output, and features.
- Explained prompt setup, reference image use, batch generation, style transfer, aspect ratio control, and result browsing.
- Clarified user security: no local credentials or API keys required; all authentication via MCP link.
- Included example commands and common use cases for efficient image generation and canvas organization.
summary: Multi-model AI image generation on a visual canvas. Supports Midjourney (relaxed/fast/turbo, v7.0, 4-image grid), Grok Imagine (6 images per call, auto I2I),...
